Title: Conventional Commits, e.g. `feat(api): add QUERY to /hash`.
It becomes the squash commit message. Use `!` for breaking changes.
See https://www.syntaqx.com/docs/engineering/commits-and-reviews
-->

## Why

The problem, and a link to the issue, design doc or ADR (`docs/adr/`).

## What

The approach, and anything surprising in the diff.

## How it was verified

Tests added, manual steps, screenshots for UI.

## Risk and rollout

Migrations, flags, how to roll back.

---

- [ ] One concern, small enough to review (aim for under ~400 changed lines)
- [ ] CI is green before asking for review
- [ ] Docs and an ADR updated if this changes behavior or a decision
